profile.subtitleJa: ベエロト人リモンの子
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下4:2は、レカブとバアナをリモンの子、ベニヤミン人と紹介します。

facts.textJa: レカブとバアナは昼休み中のイシュ・ボシェテの家に入り、彼を刺します。
ダビデはレカブとバアナに、主が自分を苦難から救い出したと告げます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;
The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.
They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
